_doc: Large full-facility sports club (Japanese 'sports club' chain style). ONE faction owns every area, so one membership (one monthly fee) covers all activities and every member/staff 'belongs' to all the furniture (requireJobFaction Any). No floor plan: every room is hideOnMap with no offsetX/offsetY, so the building only exists as the room list + the connects graph below (abstract walking minutes as door cost, like the hospital). Layout: lobby with reception and a waiting bench (also the world-map exit, the only room open to the public); corridor 1 behind it, from which every other room is members/staff only (requireFactionMembership); the locker rooms off the corridor lead to the pool; the training gym and the studio behind it; the sauna/spa beside the pool; the machine room (pool filtration) behind the pool. Open 07:00-24:00, closed overnight.
_doc_membership: membertype_jp_sports_center_member: one monthly fee, many bookable activities (MemberType.recreation.activities). RecreationUtility books one activity per visit (a day's chain may mix them); the booking copies the activity's workModule and the default behavior tree (TryFindScheduledJobNode's booked-visit branch) sandboxes by it like a shift - one random workCommand after another, across the club. Member commands are non-job (no 'job' tag), tagged 'recreation', and gated only by requireJobFaction Any (belongs to the club: members and staff alike). The club's own staff can also have visits booked here off shift without joining (Manageable.GetOfferedRecreationTypes).
_doc_staff: Staff sandbox by workModule.workCommands like the hospital's (each finished command picks a new random one; each command is offered in one area only, so they drift around the club). Front desk: single workCommand, stays at reception (talking to an on-shift clerk offers membership sign-up / cancellation - Events/sports_club_dialogue_options.json). Trainer: gym instruction / studio class / pool lifeguard. Cleaner: behavior_job TryFindNurseJobNode - com_job_cleaning wherever there is trash first, then any jp_sports_center_cleaner duty. Maintenance: equipment inspection / pool water check / filtration service. Trainer / cleaner / maintenance: two shifts (early 07-16, late 15-24, 1h handover), teams A/B on the hospital's 14-day rota so every day is covered. Front desk: one all-day post (07-24, every day). Staff commands are job commands gated like the hospital's (requireJobFaction CurrentActive + the role's MemberType). Fallback workers only hold membertype_jp_sports_center_frontdesk_npc (one all-day reception post, not assignable/joinable); every other post is left open for other NPCs or the player.
_doc_pay: Approximate 2025 Japanese part-time/contract hourly rates: front desk and cleaner 1150, trainer 1400, maintenance 1300 JPY. Late shift (15-24) rates average in the 25% legal late-night premium for 22:00-24:00 over the 9 hours: x (7 + 2 x 1.25) / 9 = x 1.056. The all-day front desk post (07-24) uses the late front desk rate, 1210.

factionInit._comment_isRentingFloor: the club owns its building outright
factionInit._comment_assignableMemberTypes: Parent IDs stand for every shift under them (Manageable.AssignableMemberTypes). Front desk is left out: its only post is the NPC-only membertype_jp_sports_center_frontdesk_npc.
factionInit._comment_joinableMemberTypes: The membership: joined at the front desk (sports_club_dialogue_options) or through Opt_ArrangeJoin_Recreation (tag memberType_recreation). Also what the club's own staff may book here off shift (Manageable.GetOfferedRecreationTypes).
factionInit._comment_fallbackWorkers: Only the NPC-only front desk post (07-24, every day) gets a fallback worker, so reception is always staffed with a single fallback worker. Every other post (front desk early/late, trainer, cleaner, maintenance) is left open for other NPCs or the player, with no fallback worker. templateID jp_store_clerk (JP_World/Characters/templates.json) until club staff portrait bases / uniforms exist.

memberTypes._comment_membershipFee: monthly dues of a typical 2025 Japanese full-facility sports club (~12,000-14,000 JPY), owed by the member's priority home - once per member, however many activities they use
memberTypes._comment_recreation: One activity per visit (RecreationActivity); its workModule drives the visit (the default behavior tree sandboxes its workCommands - TryFindScheduledJobNode's booked-visit branch). activeHours = when a visit may be booked (club open 07-24). No entranceFee: the monthly membershipFee covers every activity. An activity may also carry behaviorOverrides / Tags / AcceptanceMods of its own.

activities._comment_daysInAdvance: booked only on the day itself (planned at that day's midnight)

memberTypes._comment_joinHandler: optionTextKey names the candidate ($name$ is the only placeholder a join handler fills): at the front desk the options list the player and followers.

memberTypes._comment: Parent of the front desk post (MemberType hierarchy): never held. Its only child is the NPC-only all-day post. Single workCommand, so the clerk stays at reception all shift. The jp_sports_center_frontdesk tag (an actor tag only while on shift) is what offers the sign-up dialogue.

childMemberTypes._comment: NPC-only front desk post: one shift covering all opening hours (07-24) every day, always held by the club's one fallback worker. Under the front desk parent for its tags (sign-up dialogue) and the reception_duty requirement, but listed in neither assignableMemberTypes nor joinableMemberTypes, so it can't be assigned or joined. Pay = the late shift's rate (averages in the 22-24 premium).

memberTypes._comment: Parent of the trainer shifts. Sandbox by workCommands: gym floor instruction, a studio class, pool lifeguard duty - so trainers rotate through the gym, studio and pool.
memberTypes._comment_rota: Early 07-16 / late 15-24; team A works week A Mon Tue Fri Sat Sun + week B Wed Thu, team B the other days (the hospital's 14-day rota), so every day has an early and a late shift.

memberTypes._comment: Parent of the cleaner shifts. behavior_job TryFindNurseJobNode: com_job_cleaning wherever there is trash in the club first, then any job-tagged jp_sports_center_cleaner duty (lockers, equipment, pool deck). workCommands stay listed for the shift schedule / documentation.
memberTypes._comment_rota: Early 07-16 / late 15-24; team A works week A Mon Tue Fri Sat Sun + week B Wed Thu, team B the other days (the hospital's 14-day rota), so every day has an early and a late shift.

memberTypes._comment: Parent of the maintenance shifts. Sandbox by workCommands: equipment inspection on the gym floor, pool water check and filtration service in the machine room.
memberTypes._comment_rota: Early 07-16 / late 15-24; team A works week A Mon Tue Fri Sat Sun + week B Wed Thu, team B the other days (the hospital's 14-day rota), so every day has an early and a late shift.

Mat area - no actor cap (group classes).

COMs._doc: Member activity commands: non-job, tags [furniture, recreation, jp_sports_center, jp_sports_center_activity], gated only by requireJobFaction Any (bookable commands: the loose restriction only). Staff commands: job commands with a role tag, gated like the hospital's (requireJobFaction CurrentActive + the role's MemberType). Effects beyond the stamina/energy cost (fitness, cleanliness, water quality) are to be authored.
